SELECT DISTINCT 
CLM.CLM_ID AS CLAIM_ID,
NVL(SUBSTRING(SUB.CRS_ADDL_INFO,11,2),SUBSTRING(ORI.CRS_ADDL_INFO,11,2)) AS "Encounter Category of Service",
NVL(SUBSTRING(SUB.CRS_ADDL_INFO,13,3),SUBSTRING(ORI.CRS_ADDL_INFO,13,3)) AS "Encounter Provider Specialty", 
DATE(SUB.CRS_ADD_TS)	AS "Encounter Submission Date",
DATE(RSB.CRS_ADD_TS)	AS "Encounter Resubmission Date",
DATE(VOD.CRS_ADD_TS)	AS "Encounter Void Date"

FROM 		HS.CLM_CLAIM		AS CLM
JOIN        	HS.CDT_CLM_DT       AS CDT ON CLM.CLM_ID = CDT.CDT_CLM_ID AND CDT.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND CDT.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
LEFT JOIN		HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT	AS SUB ON CLM.CLM_ID = SUB.CRS_CLM_ID AND SUB.CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL AND SUB.CRS_TYPE IN ('023','024','025','049','050','051') --AND SUB.CRS_ADDL_INFO IN ('998403440','998403441','998403446','998403447','998403442','998403443','998403448','998403449','998403444','998403445')
									AND SUB.CRS_ADD_TS = (SELECT CRS_ADD_TS FROM HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT WHERE CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL AND CRS_TYPE IN ('023','024','025','049','050','051') AND SUB.CRS_CLM_ID = CRS_CLM_ID/* AND CRS_ADDL_INFO IN ('998403440','998403441','998403446','998403447','998403442','998403443','998403448','998403449','998403444','998403445')*/ ORDER BY CRS_ADD_TS ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY WITH UR)
LEFT JOIN 	HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT	AS RSB ON CLM.CLM_ID = RSB.CRS_CLM_ID AND RSB.CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL AND RSB.CRS_TYPE IN ('095','059') 
LEFT JOIN		HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT	AS VOD ON CLM.CLM_ID = VOD.CRS_CLM_ID AND VOD.CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL AND VOD.CRS_TYPE IN ('026','077') 
LEFT JOIN		HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT	AS ORI ON CLM.CLM_CLM_ID = ORI.CRS_CLM_ID AND ORI.CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL AND ORI.CRS_TYPE IN ('023','024','025','049','050','051')/* AND ORI.CRS_ADDL_INFO IN ('998403440','998403441','998403446','998403447','998403442','998403443','998403448','998403449','998403444','998403445')*/
									AND ORI.CRS_ADD_TS = (SELECT CRS_ADD_TS FROM HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT WHERE CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL AND CRS_TYPE IN ('023','024','025','049','050','051') AND ORI.CRS_CLM_ID = CRS_CLM_ID /*AND CRS_ADDL_INFO IN ('998403440','998403441','998403446','998403447','998403442','998403443','998403448','998403449','998403444','998403445')*/ ORDER BY CRS_ADD_TS ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY WITH UR)

WITH UR
